Method of Attack: Included five exploits to root Android devices
Tapped into Zygote Android core OS process to control app launching
Replaced referrer IDs on installed apps
Potential to steal user data, install apps without consent, or show phishing pages
Impacted Systems: Android devices running Android 5 or earlier
Attack Vector: Tainted apps installed from forums or third-party app stores
Indicators of Compromise: Rooting exploits: CVE-2014-4321, CVE-2014-4324, CVE-2013-6282 (VROOT), CVE-2015-3636 (PingPongRoot), CVE-2014-3153 (Towelroot)
Infected apps never appeared on Google Play Store
Connections to MobiSummer ad network infrastructure
